page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top, centred, with an ornamental rule beneath it. Below the chapter heading, a brace-outline diagram of the divisions of heresies (two groups), with the example column and labels beside the braces. The text resumes after each diagram. No margin notes. Catchword at the lower right. No page number printed.

main_text.head: CAP. IX. De varia diuisione hæresēon[?].
main_text.p: IAm vero propius ad institutum & opus suscceptum accedamus. Quod ut fiat, varia hæresēon[?], quæ fieri potest, diuisio à nobis proponenda est.Diui-duntur igitur hæreses
Ab authore diuersis nominibus hæreses appellantur: ut in primo Indice nostro demonstratur. A tempore autem sic distinguntur hæreses, ut dicatur

Ac quidem vera est hæc Tertulliani sententia, Vera doctrina, ait, hæreses præcessit. In omnibus enim veritas imaginem & corruptionem antecedit. Itaque id est dominicum & verum, quod prius traditum est. Hactenus ille.Ex media enim Ecclesia extiterunt hæreses velut illius morbi quidam. Nam uti è nucleo mitis oliuæ oleaster asper & sylvestris oritur:ita ex sana & suavi Christi doctrina nascitur acerba hæresis, quæ uti fungus è terra statim existit, quemadmodum ait Irenæus lib .i. cap. 33. Quo au-tem primum tempore post Christum passum extiterint hæreses, quærit Clemens lib.7. Stro-

page.notes: Title "hæresēon" and the tilde on the o of the title are uncertain. "Manichæi" is uncertain (the printed form looks like ę). "(resis." in the example column is uncertain; it may belong to the line "Ante Christum." or to "hæ-resis" in the next box. The "Am" after the drop-cap I is a decorated initial, joined as "IAm". Printing errors left as printed: "est.Diui-" and "ille.Ex" have no space; "oritur:ita" has no space. The diagram's label "vel ab" and "aliæ fuisse" are set as separate labels beside the braces. Long s is written as plain s throughout.
